instruction:
Create CSS to make:
1. All h1 elements blue
2. All paragraphs gray

success.title: 🎉 Perfect CSS!
success.details: You've successfully used element selectors to style both h1 and paragraph elements. Element selectors are perfect when you want to style all instances of a particular HTML tag.

error.title: Not quite right!
error.details:
Remember to:
• Use element selectors (h1, p)
• Set the color property
• Use proper CSS syntax with curly braces
